title: K Closest Points to Origin
statement:
Given a list of points on a 2D plane and an integer K, find the K closest points to the origin (0, 0).

Distance is measured by Euclidean distance: sqrt(x^2 + y^2).

If multiple points are equidistant from the origin, break ties by x-coordinate ascending, then y-coordinate ascending.

Print the K points sorted by distance (with the tie-breaking rule applied).
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The next N lines each contain two integers x and y.
outputFormat: K lines, each with two integers x y (the K closest points in order of distance).

examples.explanation: Distances: sqrt(18), sqrt(26), sqrt(20). Closest 2 are (3,3) and (-2,4).
